companyAnnouncements: ts-launch-blueprint: a production-ready TypeScript project template ported from py-launch-blueprint, shipping the ts-projects example CLI plus full quality gates. Commands: just all (format-check, lint, typecheck, test), just pre-commit-run (hook suite on all files), just check-deps (toolchain check), just debug-info (environment report), just setup-hooks (git hooks + commit template). See AGENTS.md for the project charter and the Justfile for all recipes.
